skill_name: Summarize the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.
workflow: The Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court is an international agreement that established an independent, permanent court to prosecute individuals for the most serious international crimes, including genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity. The Statute also defines individual criminal responsibility and outlines the jurisdiction and procedure of the court.
